exportfortranslation-error-revision-not-:
Error shown when a requested revision to export does not exist.

Parameters:
* $1 - the revision ID
exportfortranslation-error-page-has-no-r:
Error shown when the page to export has no revision.

Parameters:
* $1 - the page title
exportfortranslation-error-revision-wron:
Error shown when a requested revision to export belongs to a different page than the requested one.

Parameters:
* $1 - the revision ID
* $2 - the page title
exportfortranslation-error-revision-text:
Error shown when the text of the revision to export has been hidden with revision deletion, so it is not exported.

Parameters:
* $1 - the revision ID
* $2 - the page title
exportfortranslation-error-revision-not-:
Error shown when the revision to export has no text content that can be exported (non-text content, or content that could not be loaded).

Parameters:
* $1 - the revision ID
* $2 - the page title
